fields.summary_ko.0: Hana Securities analyst Kim Rok-ho lowered Samsung Electronics' target price from KRW 480,000 to KRW 400,000 (down 16.7%), maintaining a 'buy' investment rating.
fields.summary_ko.1: 2027 revenue forecast of KRW 1,013 trillion (up 40% YoY), operating income of KRW 624 trillion (up 61%), with HBM revenue expected to increase approximately 7-fold to KRW 91 trillion compared to this year.
fields.summary_ko.2: Securing over 50% of revenue through long-term supply contracts can reduce memory price volatility; this year's shareholder return is estimated at approximately KRW 110 trillion (KRW 70 trillion dividends + KRW 40 trillion share buybacks).
